topic: Number of pepper plants that fit in a garden bed row given plant spacing
core_question: A raised garden bed row is 18 feet long, and each pepper plant needs 2 feet of space. Find how many pepper plants fit in the row. (secondary: A lemonade stand sells 40 cups at $1 each. Ingredients cost $15 total. Find the profit.)
answer_summary: the total of 9 plants (18-foot row divided into 2-foot spacings); after the topic shift: the profit of $25 (40 cups sold at $1 each minus $15 in ingredient costs)
persona: tired and blunt; writing terse one-liners
